form.label: Vault Audit Volume Attribution: where is the ingest coming from
form.description: Attributes audit-log volume to mounts, paths, operations, namespaces and identities, then ranks high-volume / low-forensic-value patterns as filter candidates. Counts BOTH type=request and type=response, because ingest cost is billed on both. Metadata only; audit values are HMAC'd.

html.div:
Metadata only. The Vault audit device HMACs every secret value before writing it, so no panel here can render a secret. Community-built asset, not a HashiCorp product feature.
Counting rule: every panel counts both type=request and type=response, because the audit device writes and your SIEM bills for both. Counting responses only halves the number.

search.query: | tstats count AS events WHERE index=vault_audit sourcetype="vault:audit"

single.option: tstats: reads the index metadata, never the raw events

search.query: index=vault_audit sourcetype="vault:audit" | bin _time span=1d | stats count AS events BY _time | stats avg(events) AS per_day | eval per_day = round(per_day, 0)

single.option: mean over the selected window, request + response

search.query: index=vault_audit sourcetype="vault:audit" | stats count BY type

index=vault_audit sourcetype="vault:audit" | eval p = coalesce('request.path',""), mt = coalesce('request.mount_type',"") | eval low = if( (mt=="transit" AND match(p,"/(encrypt|decrypt|sign|verify|hmac|rewrap)/")) OR match(p,"^auth/token/(lookup|renew)-self$") OR match(p,"^sys/(health|seal-status|leader|ha-status)$") OR match(p,"^sys/metrics") OR match(p,"^sys/internal/ui/"), 1, 0) | stats sum(low) AS low_events, count AS total_events | eval pct = round(low_events * 100 / total_events, 1) | fields pct

single.option: share of ingest that an investigation would not miss

panel.title: Events per day, by mount type (the shape matters more than the height)

search.query: index=vault_audit sourcetype="vault:audit" | timechart span=1d count BY request.mount_type useother=t limit=10

panel.title: Top mounts by volume, with percent of total

search.query: index=vault_audit sourcetype="vault:audit" | eval ns_key = coalesce('request.namespace.path',"") | eval ns_key = if(ns_key == "", "root", ns_key) | where "$ns$" == "*" OR ns_key == "$ns$" | eval mount = ns_key . "|" . coalesce('request.mount_point',"(none)") | stats count AS events, dc(auth.display_name) AS identities, values(request.mount_type) AS mount_type BY mount | eventstats sum(events) AS total_events | eval pct_of_total = round(events * 100 / total_events, 2) | sort - events | head 20 | table mount mount_type events pct_of_total identities

index=vault_audit sourcetype="vault:audit" | eval ns_key = coalesce('request.namespace.path',"") | eval ns_key = if(ns_key == "", "root", ns_key) | where "$ns$" == "*" OR ns_key == "$ns$" | eval operation = coalesce('request.operation',"(none)"), mount_type = coalesce('request.mount_type',"(none)") | stats count AS events BY operation mount_type | eventstats sum(events) AS total_events | eval pct_of_total = round(events * 100 / total_events, 2) | sort - events | head 20 | table operation mount_type events pct_of_total

panel.title: Volume by namespace (whose budget is this?)

search.query: index=vault_audit sourcetype="vault:audit" | eval ns = coalesce('request.namespace.path',"") | eval ns = if(ns == "", "root (empty string)", ns) | stats count AS events BY ns | sort - events

panel.title: Top talkers: identities generating the most events

search.query: index=vault_audit sourcetype="vault:audit" | eval ns_key = coalesce('request.namespace.path',"") | eval ns_key = if(ns_key == "", "root", ns_key) | where "$ns$" == "*" OR ns_key == "$ns$" | eval who = coalesce('auth.display_name',"(unauthenticated / no auth block)"), k8s_sa = coalesce('auth.metadata.service_account_name',"-") | stats count AS events, dc(request.mount_point) AS mounts, values(request.mount_type) AS mount_types BY who k8s_sa | eventstats sum(events) AS total_events | eval pct_of_total = round(events * 100 / total_events, 2) | sort - events | head 20 | table who k8s_sa events pct_of_total mounts mount_types

panel.title: Filter candidates: high volume, low forensic value. Classified by path PATTERN, never by path.

search.query: index=vault_audit sourcetype="vault:audit" | eval ns_key = coalesce('request.namespace.path',"") | eval ns_key = if(ns_key == "", "root", ns_key) | where "$ns$" == "*" OR ns_key == "$ns$" | eval p = coalesce('request.path',""), mt = coalesce('request.mount_type',""), op = coalesce('request.operation',"") | eval pattern = case( mt=="transit" AND match(p,"/(encrypt|decrypt)/"), "transit encrypt/decrypt (data-plane crypto)", mt=="transit" AND match(p,"/(sign|verify|hmac|rewrap)/"), "transit sign/verify/hmac", mt=="transit", "transit other", match(p,"^auth/token/lookup-self$"), "token lookup-self", match(p,"^auth/token/renew-self$"), "token renew-self", match(p,"^auth/token/(lookup|renew|create)"), "token lookup/renew/create", match(p,"^sys/(health|seal-status|leader|ha-status)$"), "sys health / status probes", match(p,"^sys/metrics"), "sys metrics scrape", match(p,"^sys/internal/ui/"), "sys internal UI (browser chatter)", match(p,"^identity/(lookup|oidc)/"), "identity lookup", match(p,"^cubbyhole/"), "cubbyhole", match(p,"/metadata/") OR match(p,"/subkeys/"), "kv metadata / subkeys (browsing)", op=="list", "list operations (browsing)", match(p,"/login$"), "auth login", match(p,"/data/"), "kv secret data access", true(), "everything else") | eval forensic_value = case( pattern=="transit encrypt/decrypt (data-plane crypto)", "LOW: data-plane crypto, key usage provable from metrics", pattern=="transit sign/verify/hmac", "LOW-MED: signing is sometimes in audit scope", pattern=="token lookup-self", "LOW: a token asking about itself grants nothing", pattern=="token renew-self", "LOW: renewal of an already-issued token", pattern=="sys health / status probes", "LOW: load balancer and orchestrator probes", pattern=="sys metrics scrape", "LOW: monitoring scrape", pattern=="sys internal UI (browser chatter)", "LOW: UI page loads, not access", pattern=="kv metadata / subkeys (browsing)", "MED: browsing, not use, but shows intent", pattern=="list operations (browsing)", "MED: enumeration is a recon signal", pattern=="identity lookup", "MED", pattern=="cubbyhole", "MED", pattern=="auth login", "HIGH: authentication events, do not filter", pattern=="kv secret data access", "HIGH: this is the access record, do not filter", true(), "UNKNOWN: classify before filtering") | stats count AS events, dc(auth.display_name) AS identities, dc(request.mount_point) AS mounts BY pattern forensic_value | eventstats sum(events) AS total_events | eval pct_of_total = round(events * 100 / total_events, 2) | sort - events | streamstats sum(pct_of_total) AS cumulative_pct | eval cumulative_pct = round(cumulative_pct, 2) | eval verdict = if(match(forensic_value,"^LOW") AND pct_of_total >= 1, "FILTER CANDIDATE", "keep") | table pattern forensic_value events pct_of_total cumulative_pct verdict identities mounts

html.div: Before anything gets filtered. Filtering happens at the audit device or in the log pipeline, never at search time; the events above are already indexed and already paid for, so a search-time exclusion saves nothing. A blocked audit device blocks Vault (audit is fail-closed by design), so never test a filter change against the only audit device on a production cluster. "Low forensic value" is an engineering opinion: bring the percentages to whoever owns the control and let them make the retention call. A cheaper middle path than dropping is routing the LOW rows to cold storage instead of the indexed tier. And if everything else is a large row, the classifier is missing a pattern this estate runs; go look at it before quoting any number here.

panel.title: Events vs bytes: a SIEM bills for bytes, and the two rankings disagree

search.query: index=vault_audit sourcetype="vault:audit" | eval bytes = len(_raw), mount_type = coalesce('request.mount_type',"(none)") | stats count AS events, sum(bytes) AS bytes, avg(bytes) AS avg_bytes BY mount_type type | eventstats sum(bytes) AS total_bytes, sum(events) AS total_events | eval pct_of_events = round(events * 100 / total_events, 2), pct_of_bytes = round(bytes * 100 / total_bytes, 2), avg_bytes = round(avg_bytes, 0), gb = round(bytes / 1024 / 1024 / 1024, 3) | sort - bytes | head 20 | table mount_type type events pct_of_events gb pct_of_bytes avg_bytes

panel.title: What is inside "everything else" (run this if that row is large)

search.query: index=vault_audit sourcetype="vault:audit" | eval p = coalesce('request.path',"") | where NOT (match(p,"^(auth|sys|identity|cubbyhole)/") OR match(p,"/(data|metadata|subkeys|encrypt|decrypt)/") OR match(p,"/login$")) | stats count AS events BY request.mount_type request.operation request.mount_class | sort - events | head 20
